items.description: arXiv:2611.14766v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: All social interactions are situated in time. items.description: arXiv:2611.16114v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Modern software development relies on pull requests (PRs) that introduce small, targeted code changes. items.description: arXiv:2611.16265v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Looped Transformers increase effective depth by repeatedly applying a shared block, offering a parameter-efficient approach to language modeling. items.description: arXiv:2611.16289v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Coding agents often fail to meet all requirements in the task description.
